articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro em Suzano: Manifestantes fazem ato de apoio | G1
articles.standfirst: Mobilização começou no início da noite desta quinta-feira (22) na Praça dos Expedicionários, no Centro da cidade.
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro em Suzano mobiliza apoiadores na Praça dos Expedicionários durante ato organizado pelo PL para o segundo turno das eleições.
articles.body:
Manifestantes se reuniram na Praça dos Expedicionários, no Centro de Suzano , na noite desta quinta-feira (22), em um ato de apoio à candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) à Presidência da República. Ele disputa o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais com Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), no dia 25 de outubro.

A concentração começou às 18h. A manifestação foi organizada pelo PL Suzano e reuniu apoiadores da cidade e da região do Alto Tietê.

Trechos no entorno da Praça dos Expedicionários foram interditados para o trânsito de veículos por causa da mobilização.

Imagens registradas no local mostram manifestantes vestidos de verde e amarelo, com bandeiras do Brasil e materiais de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro. O grupo também levou bandeiras com o número 22 e imagens do candidato.

Manifestação em apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro em Suzano — Foto: Pedro Garcia/TV Diário

Os manifestantes devem sair da Praça dos Expedicionários e seguir em caminhada até a Praça João Pessoa, pela Avenida General Francisco Glicério, que será interditada momentaneamente para a passagem do grupo.

Pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira (22) mostrou Flávio Bolsonaro com 47% das intenções de voto e Lula com 46% . Em votos válidos, que exclui brancos, nulos e indecisos, Flávio Bolsonaro tem 50% e Lula, 50%.

articles.title: 'Não consenti nada', diz funcionária que denunciou dono do Paladino | G1
articles.standfirst: Vítima desabafou após Justiça conceder liberdade provisória a Marcelo Haddad Guerra, de 47 anos. Outras duas mulheres procuraram a polícia após a repercussão do caso.
articles.summary: Vítima desabafou após Justiça conceder liberdade provisória a Marcelo Haddad Guerra, de 47 anos. Outras duas mulheres procuraram a polícia após a repercussão do caso.
articles.body:
A funcionária do setor de recreação infantil do restaurante Paladino, em Belo Horizonte, desabafou sobre o caso de importunação sexual que denunciou à polícia no início desta semana . O suspeito do crime é o dono do estabelecimento, Marcelo Haddad Guerra, de 47 anos.

Em entrevista à TV Globo nesta quinta-feira (22), a vítima, de 20, relatou que sofreu toques indesejados nos seios sem consentimento e pediu ao homem que parasse. Ainda segundo a jovem, ele teria minimizado a atitude.

"Eu não tinha entendido ainda a gravidade da situação, porque ele não podia fazer isso. Eu não consenti nada", afirmou a funcionária, que pediu para não ser identificada na reportagem.

O suspeito foi preso em flagrante na última terça-feira (20) e, após passar por audiência de custódia, recebeu direito à liberdade provisória ( leia mais abaixo ). Nesta quinta, outras duas mulheres procuraram a polícia para denunciar que também foram vítimas dele .

Ao g1 , a defesa de Marcelo afirmou que ele nega ter cometido o crime e que confia na investigação para demonstrar sua inocência.

O Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais (TJMG) concedeu liberdade provisória a Marcelo Haddad Guerra ao considerar a condição dele como réu primário, ou seja, sem antecedentes e condenações criminais. Por se tratar de crime sexual, o auto de prisão em flagrante tramita sob sigilo.

A decisão prevê que o empresário cumpra medidas cautelares, como monitoramento por tornozeleira eletrônica e a obrigação de não se aproximar da vítima, mantendo uma distância mínima de 300 metros. Além disso, ele deverá cumprir o recolhimento domiciliar noturno durante os dias úteis, entre 20h e 6h da manhã e, em período integral, aos sábados, domingos e feriados, por três meses.

Fachada do restaurante Paladino, no bairro Braúnas, região da Pampulha, em BH — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram

articles.title: MP recorre contra soltura de empresário Ivo Kos, preso por agredir a mulher em SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Promotores pedem o restabelecimento da prisão preventiva e afirmam que a liberdade do empresário representa risco concreto à vítima; Justiça havia revogado a prisão após acordo de divórcio.
articles.summary: Promotores pedem o restabelecimento da prisão preventiva e afirmam que a liberdade do empresário representa risco concreto à vítima; Justiça havia revogado a prisão após acordo de divórcio.
articles.body:
Ivo Kos foi preso acusado de agredir a esposa, Giulia Melo Falcão Vel Kos — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

O Ministério Público de São Paulo recorreu nesta quinta-feira (22) contra a decisão da Justiça que revogou a prisão preventiva do empresário Ivo Vel Kos , preso em agosto após agredir a mulher, a cirurgiã-dentista Giulia Falcão, de 27 anos, em Pinheiros, na Zona Oeste de São Paulo.

Ivo Vel Kos, de 48 anos, é um empresário conhecido no mercado financeiro. Ele foi preso na madrugada do dia 15 de agosto e se tornou réu por lesão corporal e ameaça. Na época, Giulia publicou um relato sobre as agressões nas redes sociais e fotos do rosto. Segundo ela, decidiu tornar o caso público porque, em episódios anteriores, o marido teria negado as agressões.

"Eu vi a morte de perto. Resolvi mostrar para que minha palavra não deixasse de valer diante da dele. Ela já pratica agressão física contra mim desde o namoro e faz tortura psicológica. Meu marido tem uma imagem de bom moço, homem de honra. Eu já falei em público diversas vezes e, quando ele nega, ninguém acredita", disse. (veja mais abaixo).

A Secretaria da Administração Penitenciária informou ao g1 que Ivo deixou a Penitenciária de Potim II na quarta-feira (21), após a Justiça revogar a prisão preventiva.

Na decisão que determinou a soltura, a Justiça considerou a formalização do acordo de divórcio, a manifestação da vítima de que não se sentia mais ameaçada e não considerava necessária a manutenção da prisão, as condições pessoais favoráveis do acusado, a necessidade de tratamento médico e o período em que ele já estava preso, de mais de dois meses.

A magistrada também avaliou que o aditamento da denúncia, com a inclusão de novos fatos e de um corréu, inviabilizaria a audiência de instrução que estava marcada. Em substituição à prisão, foram impostas medidas cautelares, entre elas monitoramento eletrônico, restrições de deslocamento e ampliação das medidas protetivas à vítima.

O g1 pediu posicionamento à defesa de Ivo e aguarda retorno.

O recurso foi apresentado pelos promotores de Justiça Fabíola Sucasas, Mariana Pieragnoli e Pedro Alonso. Para o Ministério Público, a revogação da prisão, motivada, entre outros fatores, por um acordo entre o empresário e a vítima para formalizar o divórcio, não elimina o perigo de novas agressões.

Os promotores afirmam que a decisão desconsiderou elementos que, segundo a acusação, indicam a permanência de risco à vítima e à instrução do processo.

Além disso, ressaltam que o caso não se limita a lesões leves, mas envolve um episódio prolongado de agressões físicas, ameaças de morte, uso de arma de choque do tipo taser, emprego de um taco de beisebol e privação da liberdade da mulher.

Eles argumentam também que a manifestação da vítima favorável à soltura não é suficiente para demonstrar que o risco desapareceu. Segundo o recurso, o histórico do relacionamento indica um padrão de violência, reconciliação e retirada de medidas protetivas, seguido por novos episódios de agressão.

O Ministério Público também contesta o entendimento de que o acordo de divórcio justificaria a liberdade do empresário. De acordo com a acusação, episódios anteriores de violência teriam ocorrido justamente em contextos de separação.

O recurso menciona ainda que o Formulário Nacional de Avaliação de Risco aponta a ruptura do relacionamento como um possível fator de agravamento da violência.

A dependência financeira da vítima, os contatos com familiares do acusado e as tentativas de acordo também são citados pelos promotores como circunstâncias que, na avaliação deles, deveriam ser consideradas com cautela na análise do risco.

O recurso também contesta os argumentos relacionados à saúde de Ivo e ao período em que ele permaneceu preso. Segundo os promotores, pedidos semelhantes já haviam sido rejeitados por falta de comprovação de doença grave incompatível com o cárcere.

A acusação afirma ainda que os 66 dias de prisão preventiva não configuram excesso de prazo, considerando a complexidade do caso após o aditamento da denúncia. Para o Ministério Público, é contraditório usar a ampliação da acusação, que incluiu um crime mais grave, como justificativa para a soltura.

Outro ponto levantado no recurso diz respeito à situação da vítima após a libertação do empresário. Segundo o Ministério Público, ela informou que deixaria a residência do casal, enquanto a defesa pediu autorização para que Ivo voltasse ao imóvel.

Para os promotores, a situação demonstra que as medidas cautelares impostas não garantiram a proteção pretendida e levaram a vítima a sair da própria casa.

Além de pedir o restabelecimento imediato da prisão preventiva, o Ministério Público solicita o reforço das medidas cautelares.

Entre as medidas requeridas estão a proibição de o empresário morar perto da vítima e das testemunhas, o monitoramento com alerta de aproximação, a apreensão de armas e objetos utilizados nas agressões, a proibição de contato com testemunhas e a participação obrigatória em programas de reeducação e acompanhamento psicossocial.

articles.title: Aeroporto Leite Lopes tem operação de voos afetada por causa de furto de fios em Ribeirão Preto, SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Sistema de balizamento de pousos e decolagens chegou a ficar desligado após furto na noite de quarta-feira (21). Companhia aérea informou que precisou cancelar voo que saía de Campinas (SP).
articles.summary: Sistema de balizamento de pousos e decolagens chegou a ficar desligado após furto na noite de quarta-feira (21). Companhia aérea informou que precisou cancelar voo que saía de Campinas (SP).
articles.body:
O Aeroporto Estadual Leite Lopes, em Ribeirão Preto (SP), teve problemas com a operação de voos esta semana devido a um episódio de furto de fiação elétrica.

De acordo com informações da Rede Voa, responsável pela administração do terminal, o furto na noite de quarta-feira (21) ocorreu por volta das 19h e causou o desligamento temporário do sistema de balizamento de pousos e decolagens, ou seja, o conjunto de alertas visuais na pista que permitem ao piloto conduzir a aeronave à noite.

Um boletim de ocorrência foi registrado pela concessionária. Nenhum suspeito foi identificado ou preso em função do crime.

Segundo a Rede Voa, o sistema foi religado cerca de uma hora depois, por volta das 20h30. No entanto, em nota, a Azul informou que, em função do desligamento do sistema de balizamento, teve problemas em dois voos entre Campinas (SP) e Ribeirão Preto (SP) nesta quinta-feira (22).

"O voo AD4825 (Viracopos–Ribeirão Preto) desta quinta-feira, 22, precisou retornar ao aeroporto de origem. Consequentemente, o voo AD4119 (Ribeirão Preto–Viracopos) foi cancelado", informou.

Os clientes impactados, segundo a companhia, foram reacomodados em outros voos da empresa.

Pista do Aeroporto Leite Lopes, em Ribeirão Preto (SP). — Foto: Thiago Aureliano/EPTV

O episódio da última quarta-feira não foi o único. Na terça-feira (20), a Rede Voa já havia registrado um boletim de ocorrência informando que postes de balizamento luminosos da pista, chamados de pilones, tinha sido levados.

No aeroporto, a reportagem também encontrou indícios de que as invasões são comuns: o alambrado com a cerca elétrica, que deveria impedir a entrada de terceiros à pista, foi danificado com um buraco para facilitar a passagem.

Especialista em aviação, o professor do departamento de engenharia aeronáutica da USP James Rojas Waterhouse explica que a suspensão dos pousos e decolagens representa mais um transtorno do que um risco para a segurança dos voos.

Abertura em alambrado de isolamento da pista de pousos e decolagens do Aeroporto Leite Lopes, em Ribeirão Preto (SP). — Foto: Thiago Aureliano/EPTV

Atualmente, o terminal de passageiros recebe uma média de 48 mil passageiros por mês.

"Se não tiver luz no aeroporto, se não tiver fiação, eles vão ter que parar a operação. Só que, quando você para a operação à noite, Ribeirão Preto é um aeroporto muito importante para a região. Então, voos que vêm e voos que saem podem ser cancelados em decorrência disso", afirma.

A sugestão dele é que haja um plano de contingência emergencial para situações como o furto de fiação.

"Para repassar a fiação e reinstalar isso em um prazo muito curto para não parar o aeroporto ou vão ter que parar o aeroporto para operações noturnas."

articles.title: Brumadinho: STJ suspende pagamento de novo auxílio da Vale a atingidos | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão liminar, da ministra Maria Isabel Gallotti, atende a recurso apresentado pela Vale e impede levantamento dos valores depositados pela mineradora.
articles.summary: Decisão liminar, da ministra Maria Isabel Gallotti, atende a recurso apresentado pela Vale e impede levantamento dos valores depositados pela mineradora.
articles.body:
Equipes buscam vítimas de tragédia em Brumadinho — Foto: REUTERS/Adriano Machado

O Superior Tribunal de Justiça (STJ) suspendeu o pagamento do novo auxílio emergencial a atingidos pela tragédia em Brumadinho. A decisão liminar, da ministra Maria Isabel Gallotti, atende a um recurso apresentado pela Vale e impede o levantamento dos valores depositados pela mineradora até o julgamento definitivo.

Em março deste ano, o Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais (TJMG) decidiu que os repasses do benefício deveriam ser mantidos por tempo indeterminado , por entender que os efeitos do desastre continuam causando prejuízo às comunidades atingidas.

Ao recorrer ao STJ, a mineradora alegou que a determinação viola o acordo de reparação, que previa a destinação de R$ 4,4 bilhões ao Programa de Transferência de Renda (PTR) para os atingidos, e que essa é uma obrigação encerrada (entenda mais abaixo) .

"A matéria de fato é complexa, o que torna prudente a suspensão ao menos do levantamento dos valores depositados pela requerente até o julgamento do recurso pelo STJ", diz um trecho da decisão da ministra Maria Isabel Gallotti, desta quarta-feira (21).

Na prática, a magistrada impediu, por enquanto, que os valores depositados pela Vale sejam repassados aos beneficiários pela gestora do fundo, a Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV).

A Vale afirmou que não comenta processos judiciais que estão em curso.

O g1 também questionou a FGV sobre a decisão, mas não obteve retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

O rompimento da barragem da Vale em Brumadinho ocorreu em janeiro de 2019 e deixou 270 pessoas mortas. No mês seguinte, a Justiça obrigou a mineradora a fazer pagamentos emergenciais às pessoas atingidas.

Em 2021, o acordo de reparação dos danos causados pela tragédia instituiu o Programa de Transferência de Renda, no valor de R$ 4,4 bilhões, para a continuidade do pagamento. A última parcela foi paga em outubro de 2025.

No entanto, associações de atingidos buscaram a Justiça para garantir a continuidade do suporte financeiro por meio de um novo auxílio emergencial, com base na Lei 14.755/2023, que estabelece a Política Nacional de Direitos das Populações Atingidas por Barragens (PNAB).

O pedido foi deferido pela Justiça de Minas Gerais. A Vale recorreu, mas, em março, o TJMG manteve o pagamento do benefício .

articles.title: Luana Piovani curte passeio de lancha em Salvador | G1
articles.standfirst: Atriz compartilhou com fãs alguns registros de passeios na cidade, com artistas como Edvana Carvalho, Mart'nália e Lyu Arisson.
articles.summary: Atriz compartilhou com fãs alguns registros de passeios na cidade, com artistas como Edvana Carvalho, Mart'nália e Lyu Arisson
articles.body:
A atriz Luana Piovani aproveitou o dia de folga em Salvador , nesta quinta-feira (22), para curtir um passeio de lancha com amigos, por alguns dos principais pontos turísticos da cidade.

Os detalhes foram compartilhados pela artista com os fãs, nas redes sociais. Entre os locais escolhidos, o Farol da Barra e a Baía de Todos-os-Santos. "Que domingo é hoje?", comentou em um dos registros.

Em um vídeo, a atriz também brincou com os amigos, que decidiram dar um mergulho nas águas do cartão postal da capital baiana.

"Olha esse astral, esse banho de mar, Baía de Todos-os-Santos. Está bom aí, gente? Está precisando de alguma coisa?", disse.

Luana Piovani passeio de lancha em em ponto turístico de Salvador — Foto: Redes Sociais

Luana Piovani tem compartilhado momentos em Salvador desde a quarta-feira (21). Além de curtir uma praia ao lado de Mart'nália, ela também aproveitou a vida noturna.

O point escolhido foi uma festa badalada entre artistas, que acontece no bairro Santo Antônio Além do Carmo, no Centro Histórico.

Ao lado dela, estavam nomes como Edvana Carvalho e Lyu Arisson. A noite teve direito a samba e também a subir no palco da festa.

articles.title: Saiba como será debate da Globo com candidatos à Presidência da República | G1
articles.standfirst: O Fato ou Fake, serviço de checagem do Grupo Globo, preparou uma cobertura especial para verificar as declarações dos dois candidatos ao longo do debate. As checagens vão estar disponíveis na tela do seu celular.
articles.summary: O Fato ou Fake, serviço de checagem do Grupo Globo, preparou uma cobertura especial para verificar as declarações dos dois candidatos ao longo do debate. As checagens vão estar disponíveis na tela do seu celular.
articles.body:
Nesta sexta-feira (23), a Globo realiza o último debate entre os candidatos à Presidência da República. As regras incentivas a discussão de temas fundamentais para o futuro do Brasil.

As lentes representam os olhos de quase 160 milhões de eleitores. O cenário está à espera dos candidatos. É o último debate. O encontro que vai ajudar a decidir o futuro de uma das maiores democracias do planeta.

As regras assinadas pelas duas candidaturas, a estrutura do cenário e a dinâmica do encontro foram estabelecidas com um objetivo central : levar ao conhecimento dos eleitores os planos de governo, as ideias para o futuro e as propostas de cada candidato para solucionar os maiores desafios do Brasil.

São quatro blocos em que os candidatos fazem perguntas entre si. Nos três primeiros, o tema das perguntas é determinado. A cada rodada, os candidatos têm três minutos para falar. Esse tempo deve ser dividido entre: pergunta e réplica, e resposta e tréplica.

O primeiro bloco já deixa evidente quem é o personagem principal, no centro do cenário e no centro das discussões. O mediador faz o sorteio e o mapa se acende, sinalizando uma parte do Brasil. Serão cinco rodadas de perguntas e respostas em que os candidatos precisam apresentar propostas concretas e específicas para cada região do país.

Nesta sexta-feira (23), a Globo realiza o último debate entre os candidatos à Presidência da República — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Além das regiões, outro tema obrigatório completa o primeiro bloco: infraestrutura e exportação: quais são os investimentos fundamentais para melhorar o desempenho do Brasil nessa área. No segundo e no terceiro blocos, os temas vão estar no telão. A cada pergunta, o candidato pode escolher um entre dez assuntos fundamentais para o futuro do Brasil:

Ao final do terceiro bloco, seis destes assuntos terão sido escolhidos pelos candidatos para debater. No quarto bloco, o tema é livre. Cada candidato pode falar por oito minutos e dividir esse tempo da forma que quiser. Nesse último bloco, cada candidato também tem um minuto e meio para as considerações finais.

O Fato ou Fake preparou cobertura especial para verificar as declarações dos dois candidatos ao longo do debate — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

O Fato ou Fake , serviço de checagem do Grupo Globo , preparou uma cobertura especial para verificar as declarações dos dois candidatos ao longo do debate. Mais de 30 jornalistas do Grupo Globo vão trabalhar em conjunto, em busca do máximo rigor e agilidade. As checagens vão estar disponíveis na tela do seu celular, publicadas no g1 e nos sites dos jornais “O Globo”, “Valor Econômico”, “Extra” e na rádio CBN.

As declarações dos candidatos podem ser classificadas com os selos de fato , não é bem assim e fake . As primeiras checagens devem ser publicadas ainda durante o debate. Outras exigem mais tempo e uma busca mais aprofundada em fontes oficiais ou com especialistas. Por isso, o trabalho vai continuar depois do debate, ao longo da noite.

Desde que foi criado, em 2018, o Fato ou Fake analisa debates e entrevistas com candidatos. Nas eleições municipais de 2024, começou a publicar as verificações ainda com os debates no ar.

“Esse debate é, acima de tudo, a celebração da democracia e, ao mesmo tempo, um compromisso dos candidatos com o eleitor. Oportunidade para que as pessoas possam ouvir, observar, assistir, perceber o que os candidatos têm a dizer, entender quais são as propostas e, a partir daí, refletir para votar no domingo”, afirma César Tralli, jornalista e apresentador.

É impossível imaginar democracia sem debate. É a última chance de cada candidato expor suas propostas e ideias para o Brasil e de falar com dezenas de milhões de eleitores ao mesmo tempo. Na reta final, no horário nobre. Nesta sexta-feira (23), depois do Jornal Nacional .

articles.title: Apoiadores de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem atos no Recife; VÍDEO | G1
articles.standfirst: Manifestações aconteceram na noite desta quinta-feira (22), no campus da UFPE e na Avenida Boa Viagem.
articles.summary: Manifestações aconteceram na noite desta quinta-feira (22), no campus da UFPE e na Avenida Boa Viagem.
articles.body:
Apoiadores de Lula ( PT ) e Flávio Bolsonaro ( PL ), que disputam o 2º turno das eleições para a Presidência da República, realizaram atos no Recife na noite desta quinta-feira (22).

A manifestação em apoio ao presidente e candidato à reeleição foi realizada no campus da Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE), na Zona Oeste da cidade. Já a passeata em defesa do senador, chamada de "Bloquinho 22", ocupou a Avenida Boa Viagem, na Zona Sul da capital pernambucana (veja vídeo acima) .

A "Caravana pra fazer acontecer: a gente que decide" começou por volta das 19h, em frente ao Centro de Artes e Comunicação (CAC).

O ato contou com a participação de Guilherme Cortez ( PSOL ), deputado estadual reeleito por São Paulo, do deputado federal eleito Jones Manoel (PSOL) e do ex-vereador do Recife Ivan Moraes (PSOL), que foi candidato ao governo de Pernambuco em 2026, ficando em 3º lugar.

Imagens enviadas ao g1 mostram apoiadores de Lula no ato dentro da UFPE gritando palavras de ordem em apoio ao presidente. Também é possível ver a aglomeração na avenida à beira-mar, com eleitores de Flávio vestidos de verde-amarelo.

O "Bloquinho 22" começou também por volta das 19h, na Pracinha de Boa Viagem. Segundo a organização do evento, os manifestantes seguem em passeata até o Parque Dona Lindu.

Participam da manifestação o deputado federal Nikolas Ferreira (PL) e Lucas Pavanato, deputado federal eleito por São Paulo, além de políticos locais, como o também deputado federal Mendonça Filho (PL) e o vereador e deputado estadual eleito Gilson Machado Filho (Podemos).

articles.title: Caminhoneiro bêbado é preso após bloquear rua com carreta em MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Teste apontou quase o triplo do limite legal de álcool para crime de trânsito; manobra errada causou estragos e fechou o trânsito no cruzamento.
articles.summary: Teste apontou quase o triplo do limite legal de álcool para crime de trânsito; manobra errada causou estragos e fechou o trânsito no cruzamento.
articles.body:
Um caminhoneiro de 54 anos foi preso por dirigir bêbado na tarde desta quinta-feira (22), no centro de Várzea Grande , região metropolitana de Cuiabá. Ele tentou fazer uma curva com uma carreta grande, perdeu o controle e bateu no muro de uma casa e na calçada, bloqueando toda a rua. O teste do bafômetro confirmou que ele havia bebido quase o triplo do limite que já é considerado crime por lei.

Segundo a Guarda Municipal, o motorista tentava virar entre as ruas Napoleão José da Costa e Santo Antônio, mas o veículo ficou atravessado e não conseguiu sair do lugar. Ninguém conseguia passar pelo local, nem a pé nem de carro.

Ao conversarem com o homem, os guardas perceberam que ele parecia alcoolizado e pediram para ele soprar o bafômetro. O teste marcou 0,81 mg/L de álcool no ar expelido, confirmando a embriaguez. Ele foi levado direto à delegacia para prestar esclarecimentos.

A tentativa de retirar a carreta do local causou transtornos por causa do tamanho do veículo e do risco de estragar ainda mais as casas vizinhas. Uma empresa de guincho foi chamada para ajudar na retirada com o apoio de um motorista experiente nesse tipo de manobra.

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, a Guarda Municipal permanecia no local para organizar o trânsito até que a rua fosse totalmente liberada.

articles.title: Trans man Taylor Winters and wife Chloe are expecting their first child after undergoing IVF using his eggs frozen before transition and her womb; couple used sperm donor to conceive
articles.summary: A transgender man and his wife are preparing to welcome their first child together after undergoing IVF using his eggs, frozen before his transition, and
articles.body: A transgender man and his wife are preparing to welcome their first child together after undergoing IVF using his eggs, frozen before his transition, and her womb. Taylor Winters, 42, and his wife Chloe, 33, are expecting a baby girl in January 2027 after a challenging fertility journey that included an unsuccessful first IVF attempt.Taylor, who began his medical transition in his 30s, had frozen his eggs before starting testosterone because he wanted to have biological children, although he had never imagined himself carrying a pregnancy. The couple used a sperm donor to conceive, with Chloe carrying the baby. Their journey has now brought them closer to fulfilling their dream of starting a family.Taylor Winters and wife Chloe share their IVF journeySpeaking about the experience, Chloe, a social media manager from Watford, Hertfordshire, explained that the couple had to undergo hormone treatment before beginning IVF. Their first embryo transfer took place in March 2026 but was unsuccessful, leaving them devastated.However, they were determined to try again without waiting too long. The couple underwent another round of IVF in May 2026, which resulted in a successful pregnancy.Chloe told SWNS that the wait for the pregnancy test was particularly emotional. Recalling the moment they discovered the treatment had worked, she said they woke up at around 5 am on the day they were due to test because they could not sleep the night before.“It was amazing and such an amazing feeling especially after having such devastating news the first time around,” she said.Taylor Winters froze his eggs before transitioningTaylor grew up in Transylvania, Romania, and said he knew from the age of five that he was a boy. He recalled cutting his hair, refusing to wear skirts and trying to urinate like boys. According to him, his parents were supportive.He later moved to Germany in March 2014 before relocating to the UK in March 2015 following the breakdown of his relationship at the time. It was in the UK that he began exploring his transition more seriously and met Chloe in 2016.After undergoing psychological assessments and other tests, Taylor began taking testosterone in November 2017, aged 34. Before starting hormone therapy, he decided to freeze his eggs because he had always wanted the possibility of having biological children.Taylor subsequently underwent top surgery in October 2019 and a hysterectomy in November 2023.Speaking about his transition, he described the experience as liberating, particularly after undergoing top surgery.“It was amazing not having to hide my chest – to go the beach and not have to wear a bra,” he said.Couple want both children to have a biological connectionTaylor and Chloe have also discussed expanding their family in the future. They hope to have another child using Chloe’s eggs and the same sperm donor, allowing both partners to have a biological connection to their children.Explaining his decision to preserve his fertility before transitioning, Taylor said he had always wanted biological children but had never wanted to experience pregnancy himself.“We’re using both our eggs to start a family so we each have a biological connection,” he said.Chloe said having a family of their own had always been important to her and that IVF had given them an opportunity to fulfil that dream.“Having IVF as an option for us is such a blessing. We both have a lot of love to give and have the best family and support around us, and our children would always be loved and accepted for who they are,” she said.She also emphasised that being transgender does not prevent someone from building a loving relationship and family.“You can be in a healthy and happy relationship if you’re transgender,” Chloe added.Chloe is 24 weeks pregnant as couple prepare to welcome baby girlChloe is currently 24 weeks pregnant and said the pregnancy has been progressing well. The couple have been documenting the growth of her baby bump and enjoying regular scans, including seeing their baby's heartbeat.She described the experience as exciting, although the journey to parenthood had been long and emotionally demanding.Taylor has supported Chloe throughout the process, attending every appointment and helping her through the pregnancy.“For me, I’ve been there supporting and I’ve been to every single appointment and supporting her as much as I can. She’s going through it, it’s the least I can do,” he said.As they prepare to welcome their baby girl in January 2027, Taylor said he was looking forward to the moment he could finally hold his child.“The feeling of holding our baby girl for the first time is just going to be amazing,” he said.You use AI every day. articles.title: MEA calls out UN report for saying Dawood Ibrahim's D-company India-based
articles.summary: New Delhi: India slammed a UN special rapporteur’s report which described Pakistan-based gangster Dawood Ibrahim’s D-company as an India-based criminal
articles.body: New Delhi: India slammed a UN special rapporteur’s report which described Pakistan-based gangster Dawood Ibrahim’s D-company as an India-based criminal group. Pointing to “glaring inaccuracies” in the report, India warned that such incompetence caused tremendous harm to the global body.First secretary in India’s permanent mission to UN, Raghoo Puri, said the outfit and its chief were wanted in India in connection with the 1993 Mumbai blasts. “Let me correct it for the record. This individual fled India much before the 2003 listing, and it was during this period... that he was listed for being associated with Al Qaida and with Osama bin Laden,” Puri said.Dawood still wanted, lives where Osama died: India at UNFirst secretary in India’s permanent mission to UN, Raghoo Puri, was responding to a report by Ben Saul, the special rapporteur on the ‘Promotion and Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms while Countering Terrorism’.“My delegation has been pointing out in other forums as well our serious concern at the unacceptable situation of the SR (special rapporteur) releasing reports with factual inaccuracies, while not being held accountable for them,” Puri said.He said this presented member-states with a fait accompli, an unfortunate situation for an organisation already facing challenges to its legitimacy. “It is in this context that we would like to point out some particularly glaring inaccuracies as far as my country is concerned,” Puri said.Puri underlined that the report by Ben Saul said in 2003, the United Nations Security Council listed the chief of a criminal group, “the India-based D-Company”, for association with Al Qaida.“Read in isolation, this line paints a very different picture from the actual reality,” Puri said. “This is clearly written in the narrative summary of reasons of listing under the 1267 sanctions regime,” he added, referring to UN Security Council’s Al Qaida sanctions regime. “Not mentioning this fact is regrettable, and such incompetence on part of special mandate holders does this organisation tremendous harm,” Raghoo Puri added.Puri said Dawood remained a wanted criminal in India and according to the UN listing, he resided in the same country where Osama Bin Laden was found and killed, making a clear reference to Pakistan. articles.title: Resignation by Justice Yashwant Varma may end Lok Sabha proceedings
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Ongoing proceedings in Lok Sabha for removal of Justice Yashwant Varma, who was indicted by an inquiry committee over the discovery of huge
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Ongoing proceedings in Lok Sabha for removal of Justice Yashwant Varma, who was indicted by an inquiry committee over the discovery of huge sums of unaccounted money from his residence, are likely to be called off due to the view that his resignation has rendered the exercise unnecessary.The three-member panel led by SC judge Aravind Kumar was allowed to complete its probe despite Varma, a judge in Allahabad HC, resigning on April 10. With Speaker Om Birla accepting the report, it was believed that Parliament would proceed with impeachment proceedings to send out a message against judicial corruption.Further action may be considered in accordance with law: ReportJustice Yashwant Varma’s name still figuring on the list of judges on the HC website had bolstered the view. However, sources said legal opinion, backed by a court verdict, that an HC judge’s resignation comes into effect as soon as he resigns may prevail in what was earlier seen as a legal grey area.Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, who had constituted the inquiry committee, is likely to consult different political parties before making a pronouncement on the issue in Parliament’s next session. While the committee’s report was tabled in LS and RS on Aug 12, there was no discussion amid the bitter stand-off between the opposition and govt.The committee in its report had indicted Justice Varma for the recovery of wads of 500-rupee notes in his official residence at Delhi, its unexplained disappearance, and an evasive judge failing to explain “presence, source or ownership” of the huge money. It had recommended further action.The report recommended “such further action as may be considered in accordance with law” against him. It said his explanation “remained evasive and unsatisfactory when tested against the evidence of independent official witnesses and corroborative material”.If Varma is considered to have resigned, a likelihood, he will also no longer enjoy the legal immunity given to the higher judiciary. It remains to be seen if govt considers criminal investigation against him under anti-corruption laws over an incident which had drawn widespread outrage.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Items recovered in search for missing fishing boat and crew
articles.summary: Tam Murray, 40 and Murdo Morrison, 23 remain missing after their vessel disappeared off Lewis and the body of crewmate Douglas Craigie was found at sea.
articles.body:
Items belonging to a fishing boat that vanished off the north coast of the Isle of Lewis last week have been recovered as the search for the vessel and two missing crew members continues.

Norman "Tam" Murray, 40 and Murdo Morrison, 23, were on board the Kilda when it disappeared on 13 October.

The body of crewmate Douglas Craigie, 49, was recovered from the sea in the early hours of the following morning by rescuers.

On Thursday, police confirmed that items belonging to the vessel had been recovered from what was described as "an area of interest" off the coast near Port of Ness.

The search was carried out by Police Scotland's marine and dive unit and partners.

A Marine Accident Investigation Branch (MAIB) exclusion zone has been in place for divers and vessels in an area between the Butt of Lewis and Port of Ness, but this will be lifted from 23:59 on Thursday.

Insp Neil Taylor, local area inspector for the Western Isles, said the search was a "complex operation" and asked for officers to be given "time and space" to carry out inquiries.

He said: "Efforts are continuing to work with partners and we are doing everything we can to get answers.

"While the Marine Accident Investigation Branch (MAIB) exclusion zone will be lifted tonight, we would urge people not to put themselves at any risk.

"Please do not attempt to carry out searches in areas which put you at risk of harm."

A GoFundMe for the families affected by the event has raised more than £148,000, against a target of £110,000.

articles.title: As homes spread across Los Angeles’ forested hills, black bears enter backyards, swimming pools and chicken coops, forcing residents to adapt to closer encounters
articles.summary: Los Angeles is known for its freeways and film sets, but its northern foothills are also home to black bears.
articles.body: Los Angeles is known for its freeways and film sets, but its northern foothills are also home to black bears. As communities expand along the edges of the San Gabriel Mountains, bears are increasingly appearing in backyards, swimming pools, fruit trees and chicken coops. Residents and wildlife experts are learning how to share these spaces while reducing the risk of conflict. In a September 2026 report for The Guardian titled “Bear-y good neighbors: humans and animals are learning to live together in an expanding LA”, Visser examined how encounters are changing life in foothill communities. Wilson Sherman, a doctoral student at the University of California, Los Angeles, who studies human-wildlife interactions, said black bears are adaptable omnivores capable of eating many of the same foods as people. California has an estimated 49,000 to 71,000 black bears, according to the California Department of Fish and Wildlife. The department's 2020–2024 average was 59,851 bears, and it describes the statewide population as stable over the past decade.Black bears in Los Angeles: why bears enter backyards, swimming pools and chicken coopsBlack bears have long lived in California, but expanding communities have brought more homes into contact with their habitat. Sherman told The Guardian that human-bear interactions have increased since the 1990s as communities have grown. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife’s guidance on black bears confirms that the species lives in natural, rural and residential areas. The department also notes that most wild animals naturally avoid or fear people, and that black bear encounters resulting in human injury are rare in California. Food is a major reason bears enter residential areas. Sherman identified pet food left outdoors, koi ponds, fruit trees carrying large quantities of fruit and swimming pools as features that can attract bears. Human food is not necessarily more appealing to bears than natural food, but it can provide calories more efficiently. As Sherman explained, a half-eaten pizza in a rubbish bin can offer an easier source of energy than finding equivalent calories in acorns and ants.The availability of food around people may also affect bear reproduction. The Guardian reported that bears living or foraging near people tend to reproduce more frequently, likely because human food is more calorie-dense and easier to obtain than many natural food sources. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife warns that bears can become habituated to human food and may grow too bold around people. For people moving into foothill neighbourhoods, the encounters can come as a surprise. Residents may expect suburban surroundings without realising that their gardens and streets overlap with wildlife habitat. Sherman said people he had spoken to generally became accustomed to the bears over time. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife nevertheless advises residents to keep their distance from bears.Bear sightings in 2026: hyperphagia, wildfires and climate pressuresBear encounters tend to rise in late summer and early autumn, when black bears enter a period known as hyperphagia. During this phase, they eat heavily to build fat reserves before winter. Alex Heeran, a research scientist at the California Department of Fish and Wildlife who studies the human dimensions of wildlife encounters, told The Guardian that September is often a particularly active month for reports. The timing also coincides with outdoor activities such as Labour Day picnics and camping trips. Wildlife officials receive reports of bears damaging fences, entering sheds and making a mess while searching for food. Heeran said, “a lot of the conflict can be prevented.” The California Department of Fish and Wildlife separately advises residents to secure food and rubbish that could attract bears.Climate pressures may add to the challenge. The Guardian reported that warmer summers can change the availability of natural food and prompt bears to expand their ranges. It also linked the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires to a shortage of natural food sources that encouraged bears near Los Angeles to search for food in neighbourhoods. Local authorities have also highlighted the role of rubbish. The City of Sierra Madre’s wildlife guidance urges residents to use bear-resistant bins and secure their lids. Its rules prohibit leaving refuse, pet food or other food sources where they are likely to feed wildlife, with violations subject to fines.Living with bears in Los Angeles: bear-resistant bins, fruit trees and Monrovia’s BlondieSome residents have adapted to regular bear visits. Brian Gordon and his partner moved to Monrovia four years before The Guardian report, living in the last house before the Angeles National Forest begins. A family of bears wandered through their garden around the time they bought the property. The couple now regularly see bears using their swimming pool and document the encounters on their Instagram account, PoolBearLife. They said they keep rubbish bins clean, remove potential food sources and give the animals space. Their experience has changed their understanding of the bears: rather than treating every visit as an attack, they see the animals passing through a garden that borders the forest. They also acknowledge that precautions are necessary, including when a bear finds food or drink stored in a garage.Not every encounter ends peacefully. Earlier in 2026, a mother bear known as Blondie was euthanised after officials determined that she had swiped at residents on 2 occasions, causing minor injuries. Her 2 cubs were placed in captivity, where they are being raised with the hope that they can eventually return to the wild. Monrovia residents were angered by the decision. Mayor Becky Shevlin told the Los Angeles Times that the city had not been part of the decision and said officials were devastated, particularly because Blondie had young cubs. Sherman said social media footage of bears can build empathy for wildlife, but warned against portraying them as harmless characters. He said black bears are “by nature not particularly aggressive unless they are put in a dangerous or threatening situation, but they can cause damage.” The California Department of Fish and Wildlife warns that bears habituated to human food may become too bold around people.The California Department of Fish and Wildlife advises residents to secure rubbish, recycling and compost in bear-resistant containers; pick ripe fruit and collect fallen fruit; clean outdoor grills after use; keep pets secure; and place livestock in protected pens at night. It also recommends electric fencing around chicken coops and warns people not to feed bears. Feeding big-game mammals, including bears, is prohibited under California regulations. The California Department of Fish and Wildlife advises people to keep their distance, let the bear know they are there, make themselves look bigger, make noise and back away slowly. People should avoid running or making eye contact and keep children and pets close. The department also advises carrying bear spray. People should allow the bear to leave the area. If a black bear makes contact, the department advises fighting back and then calling 911.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Heavy rain forecast as first of two named storms sweeps across Scotland
articles.summary: The Met Office has issued a yellow warning for rain across most of central and eastern Scotland on Friday.
articles.body:
Scotland is braced for a wet and windy weekend as two named storms hit in two days.

Storm Austen is the first to sweep across the country, with the Met Office issuing a a yellow warning for rain in central and eastern areas from 06:00 on Friday until midnight.

Forecasters say some places could experience 60-80 mm of rain, with a risk of flooding and travel disruption.

Storm Boelo will follow hard on its heels on Saturday, with another yellow weather warning issued, this time for high winds, for the whole of mainland Scotland, the Western Isles and Orkney.

Two storms in two days as Austen and Boelo target UK

The wind warning will come into force from 18:00 on Saturday and last until 21:00 on Sunday.

The wind speeds are expected build on Saturday afternoon, reaching a peak overnight.

Gusts of 50-65mph are forecast widely and could reach 80mph in exposed locations.

The storm will also bring wet and windy weather across the whole of the UK on Saturday with poor travelling conditions expected due to surface water and spray on faster roads and motorways.

Network Rail Scotland said that trains on Friday will be slowed down to keep people safe in the areas expected to see the heaviest rain.

Speed restrictions will be in place on parts of the West Coast Main Line and East Coast Main Line, as well as routes across southern and eastern Scotland.

It said some journeys would take longer as a result, but that the restrictions meant trains could continue running through areas where the weather is at its worst.

Speed restrictions for trains are also expected in some areas as the second storm moves across the country over the weekend.

Craig Gorman, head of operational weather strategy at Network Rail Scotland, said: "We can't control the weather, but we can make sure we're as ready as possible for whatever it brings.

"We know any disruption from these storms will be frustrating, particularly as it's the weekend, but we'll do everything we can to keep people moving wherever it's safe to do so."

Mark Ilderton, ScotRail service delivery director, said: "Safety is always our top priority and with weather warnings in place as Storm Austen and Storm Boelo bring heavy rain and strong winds to parts of Scotland this weekend, there is an increased risk of flooding and disruption on the railway."

He advised customers to check services before they travel.

Power cuts are possible, which could also affect mobile phone coverage and other services.

There is a small risk of damage to buildings, including roof tiles being blown off, while flying debris could pose a danger to the public.

articles.summary: A sledgehammer attack on an Iwo Jima statue near Marine Corps Base Quantico left one Marine statue decapitated, causing hundreds of thousands in damage.
articles.body: A Virginia man was arrested after allegedly using a sledgehammer to knock the head off a Marine figure depicted in an Iwo Jima statue near Marine Corps Base Quantico in Virginia, causing hundreds of thousands of dollars in damage to the historic military monument, police said. Officers with the Prince William County Police Department responded at about 10:13 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 21, to reports of vandalism at the statue near Richmond Highway and Fuller Road in Quantico, Virginia. Police identified the suspect as Miguel Alonso Maldonado Soriano, 27, of Stafford, Virginia, who was allegedly striking the monument with a sledgehammer when officers arrived. MASKED MAN CAUGHT ON CAMERA SMASHING VIRGIN MARY STATUE WITH A HAMMER OUTSIDE NYC CHURCH Authorities said Maldonado Soriano was detained and arrested after officers discovered extensive damage to the limestone sculpture, which commemorates one of the most recognizable moments in American military history. The damage included the complete removal of one Marine's head, along with damage to other figures depicted raising the American flag during the Battle of Iwo Jima in World War II, according to authorities. Images of the damaged monument show the figure farthest to the right missing its head, while another Marine has visible gouges across his helmet and face, police told Fox News Digital. A third figure sustained damage to a bayonet attached to a gun slung over his back. Police estimated the damage would cost hundreds of thousands of dollars to repair. WOMAN ACCUSED OF DEFACING WWII MEMORIAL WITH SPRAY PAINT INDICTED BY FEDERAL GRAND JURY Maldonado Soriano faces charges of felony destruction of property, trespassing with intent to damage property and felony injury to a monument. He is being held without bond, and a court date has not yet been announced. Authorities have not disclosed a possible motive for the alleged attack or indicated whether the monument can be repaired. The damaged statue is a 9-foot limestone depiction of the iconic World War II flag-raising on Mount Suribachi during the 1945 Battle of Iwo Jima. articles.title: Ecuador opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez arrested in campaign finance probe
articles.summary: Gonzalez’s Citizen Revolution Movement has denounced the arrest as politically motivated, calling for her release.
articles.body:
Ecuadorian opposition leader Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested as part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in the financing of her 2023 presidential campaign.

Local media reported on Thursday that Gonzalez, a prominent left-wing politician and ally of former President Rafael Correa, was detained in Canuto, a rural town in western Ecuador.

She lost presidential elections to right-wing President Daniel Noboa in both 2023 and 2025.

In a statement on social media, Ecuador’s Attorney General’s Office said it had executed arrest warrants against three people suspected of money laundering.

Seven people are under investigation over “inconsistencies in the contributions and the lawful source of the funds” during the 2023 presidential campaign.

Investigators are examining the use of a network of entities to channel approximately $500,000 for campaign advertising between May and August 2023.

The attorney general’s office has alleged that the money may have been transferred improperly, without disclosing the sources of the money or the identities of contributors.

The investigation, known as the Laberinto case, follows an earlier probe into alleged irregular campaign financing. Authorities have previously investigated claims that money brought from Venezuela was used to finance Gonzalez’s 2023 presidential bid. Gonzalez has denied wrongdoing.

Gonzalez described the accusations as “absurd” in a post on the social media platform X, comparing her situation to that of a political prisoner.

She also called on her supporters to unite in pursuit of democracy in the face of the “Noboa dictatorship”.

“I will respond with the dignity of Ecuadorians who owe nothing and who are committed to achieving freedom for Ecuador and a better future for the country,” she wrote of her arrest.

Gabriela Rivadeneira — the president of the Citizen Revolution Movement, of which Gonzalez is a member — also denounced the arrest as political persecution. She demanded Gonzalez’s immediate release.

Correa, who served as president from 2007 to 2017, also rejected the allegations, calling the case persecution.

“Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH!!!!” Correa wrote on X.

Gonzalez, a lawyer and former member of Ecuador’s National Assembly, fought a notably acrimonious presidential race against Noboa. The two candidates faced each other in a run-off race in April 2025, resulting in Noboa winning with more than 55 percent of the vote.

But Gonzalez rejected the results as fraudulent and demanded a recount. Noboa’s government, meanwhile, accused her political movement of conspiring with criminal groups to plot attacks against the right-wing leader.

Noboa, a close ally of United States President Donald Trump, has cracked down on the opposition since winning re-election last year.

In March, the Citizen Revolution Movement was suspended from participating in upcoming local elections. The local elections are scheduled for November 29.

articles.title: Paul Finebaum says ESPN banned him from shows after telling OutKick he might run for office
articles.summary: Paul Finebaum confirms ESPN sidelined him after his OutKick interview about running for Alabama Senate as a Republican and voting for Trump.
articles.body: Paul Finebaum says ESPN did, indeed, sideline him after an interview with OutKick last year. Last September, Finebaum told Clay Travis during a podcast that he was considering leaving ESPN to run for U.S. Senate in Alabama as a Republican, revealing that he had also voted for President Donald Trump in 2024. A week later, Travis reported that ESPN had removed Finebaum from his scheduled television appearances because of the interview. "Per sources: Disney/ESPN has removed @finebaum from appearing on @ESPN since his @outkick interview expressing interest in running as a Republican for senate in Alabama. ESPN has canceled all network appearances on all shows, including some that have occurred for a decade plus," Travis posted on X. An ESPN public relations executive disputed the report, despite the obvious fact that Finebaum had disappeared from his usual ESPN television appearances, even following a weekend of major college football upsets. "This is not true at all. The below is TOTALLY FALSE," ESPN's Bill Hofheimer wrote above Travis' report. Finebaum sided with Travis' version of events this week. "Of course, I was sidelined," Finebaum told Awful Announcing when asked about the story. "I’d done the same shows every day for 13 years, and the next thing you know, I’m not on there after a college football weekend." OutKick asked ESPN for comment Thursday following Finebaum's remarks. The network sent the following statement: "As we stated last year, Finebaum was never banned." The dispute is largely a matter of semantics. Finebaum was not booked for his regular appearances on shows like SportsCenter and Get Up the week after his interview with OutKick. He did, however, continue hosting his eponymous show on SEC Network and ESPN Radio. He remained on some ESPN platforms. The network can also claim it simply chose not to book him for certain television appearances and tried out other personalities in case Finebaum ultimately left the company to run for office. In fact, that is what we hear ESPN told people who inquired at the time. As a matter of technicality, ESPN did not "ban" Finebaum. However, what is technically true is not always the same as what is obvious. What appears obvious is that ESPN responded to Finebaum's interview by not booking him on the shows he has spent the past decade appearing on during the college football season. Further, it would have been understandable for ESPN to take issue with Finebaum making national news about a potential political campaign while still employed by the company. ESPN did not respond by removing him from his regular television appearances or publicly preparing replacements in case he left the company to seek office. That contrast makes ESPN's handling of Finebaum harder to dismiss as ordinary programming rotation. articles.title: Judge orders Trump to give deposition for his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against BBC
articles.summary: President Donald Trump must sit for a deposition by Dec. 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC over its 2024 "Panorama" documentary.
articles.body: A judge on Thursday ordered President Donald Trump to sit for a deposition as part of his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC). U.S. Magistrate Judge Enjoliqué Lett said Trump must give his deposition by Dec. 11 unless the discovery deadline is extended beyond Dec. 18. This followed complaints by the BBC's legal counsel about the delay in the deposition after Trump had canceled a previously scheduled deposition for Oct. 16. TRUMP THREATENED BY JUDGE WITH SANCTIONS IF HE DOESN’T SIT FOR DEPOSITION IN $10 BILLION BBC DEFAMATION SUIT "The formerly respected and now disgraced BBC defamed President Trump by intentionally, maliciously and deceptively doctoring his speech in a brazen attempt to interfere in the 2024 presidential election," a spokesperson for Trump's legal team told Fox News Digital. "The BBC has a long pattern of deceiving its audience in coverage of President Trump, all in service of its own leftist political agenda. President Trump’s powerhouse lawsuit is holding the BBC accountable for its defamation and reckless election interference just as he has held other fake news mainstream media responsible for their wrongdoing." A spokesperson for the BBC declined to comment. JUDGE LIMITS BBC FROM RELITIGATING JAN 6 IN TRUMP LAWSUIT OVER MISLEADING DOCUMENTARY EDIT The BBC previously filed a motion to compel Trump’s deposition. The BBC had said it understood that Trump’s deposition requires "additional planning," and he "accepted the obligations of civil litigation" when he chose to file the lawsuit. Trump filed a $10 billion lawsuit against the BBC late last year for its 2024 "Panorama" documentary that distorted his remarks to supporters on Jan. 6, 2021. Critics claim the documentary was misleading because it omitted Trump's call for supporters to protest peacefully, splicing together separate portions of a lengthy address to give a wrong impression. "We're going to walk down to the Capitol. And I'll be there with you. And we fight — we fight like hell," the documentary showed Trump saying. In reality, Trump said, "We're going to walk down to the Capitol. And we're going to cheer on our brave senators and congressmen and women, and we're probably not going to be cheering so much for some of them, because you'll never take back our country with weakness. You have to show strength, and you have to be strong." TRUMP WINS PERMISSION TO FILE AMENDED COMPLAINT IN $10B DEFAMATION LAWSUIT AGAINST BBC It wasn't until 54 minutes later that Trump called on his supporters to "fight like hell" for election integrity. The BBC previously issued an apology for the erroneous edit and said it had pulled the program from its platforms. Despite the apology, the broadcaster has insisted the mistake is not enough for a defamation claim. The controversy led to the resignations of BBC News CEO Deborah Turness and BBC Director-General Tim Davie. articles.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skin care sales
articles.summary: The beauty giant's CEO says the use of GLP-1s is "a very important phenomenon for us".
articles.body:
Beauty giant L'Oreal says the rise of weight loss drugs has affected beauty and skin care sales, as it designs products to specifically target some side effects of rapid weight loss.

The company's head Nicolas Hieronimus said the beauty market was proving resilient in a challenging global context, and that the use of GLP-1s was "a very important phenomenon for us".

He told an investor call that the rise in their use was "having an impact on beauty consumption and skin care consumption in particular".

L'Oreal, which owns other popular brands including Maybelline and La Roche-Posay, announced on Thursday that sales in the three months to September rose by 7.7%, above analyst expectations.

The use of GLP-1s has boomed in popularity in recent years, after drugs developed to treat diabetes such as Ozempic, Wegovy and Mounjaro were found to also lead to significant weight loss because they supress the appetite.

While it is not caused by GLP-1 drugs directly, rapid weight loss can, for some people, come with a side effect of loose skin - including around the face.

Hieronimus said L'Oreal's brands SkinCeuticals and Kiehl's have products "that have been designed to work alongside and complement GLP-1 and its side effects on skin sagging" and other effects related to rapid weight loss.

L'Oreal has also moved further into the clinical aesthetic space, increasing its stake in dermatology firm Galderma to 20% last December.

Both companies have been testing products on GLP-1 users worried about loose skin in separate clinical trials, according to Reuters.

Galderma owns popular aesthetic products including Sculptra, an injectable aimed at stimulating collagen production, and Restylane, which is an injectable dermal filler.

Last year the aesthetic firm released a report into the rise of GLP-1 use and related concerns about changes in facial appearance.

Its own survey of weight loss medication users found the vast majority had noticed changes to their facial appearance after using those drugs.

articles.title: Raye wins the Mercury Prize with This Music May Contain Hope
articles.summary: The pop star beat artists like Paul McCartney, Suede and Jade Thirlwall to lift the £25,000 prize.
articles.body:
Raye has won the 2026 Mercury Prize for her show-stopping second album This Music May Contain Hope.

A pop record sprinkled with golden age Hollywood glamour, it beat the likes of Sir Paul McCartney, Olivia Dean and Jade to scoop the £25,000 prize.

"I couldn't tell you how grateful I am to be holding this," said Raye, clutching her trophy at Newcastle's Utilita Arena. "I'm shaking, I'm jet-lagged, I'm tired. It's all blurry."

It is the first time a pop album has won the coveted prize - which recognises the best British or Irish album of the last 12 months - since M People's Elegant Slumming in 1994.

Speaking to the BBC afterwards, Raye said she'd "poured everything I had" into the record, which features the global hit song Where Is My Husband?

"I made this album not focusing on commercial [success], not focusing on making things cookie-cutter," said the 28-year-old.

"Some of these songs are seven minutes. They're indulgent. They're maximalist."

Across 17 tracks and 73 minutes, the record tells a cinematic story about a relationship that ends in tears on the rainy streets of Paris, then follows our plucky heroine as she dusts off the debris and emerges stronger and more resilient.

Along the way, it features both of her grandparents, the soul legend Al Green, four separate orchestras and more than 100 musicians.

Released in March, the album went straight to the top of the UK charts and won glowing reviews from critics.

Rolling Stone magazine praised its "old-school show-tune razzle-dazzle [and] big-band swing frills", while the NME raved that, "Raye's agile voice has never sounded so good, and her pen has never been so strong".

In the BBC's own review, it was described as an "eccentric, kitsch and dramatic" record where Raye "unapologetically goes for broke".

Raye comes out swinging on her new album, This Music May Contain Hope

But the album almost never happened. Two years ago this week, the singer's car was stolen , along with all of her songwriting notebooks and demos.

Although they were eventually recovered, it delayed work on This Music May Contain Hope by almost a year.

Looking back, she was philosophical about the delay.

"I was distraught. I was very worried, but you know, it all turned out great.

"Every little slip, every little accident, every little thing, it creates the path that you take.

"And it's easy to spend time wishing things were the other way. But right now, I certainly do not."

Established in 1992, the Mercury Prize was envisaged as an antidote to the commercially-focused Brit Awards, recognising albums that moved music forwards, without recourse to fashion or trends.

Of the last 35 winners, 20 have been debut albums - from artists including Arctic Monkeys, Suede and Franz Ferdinand.

Many people have mistakenly assumed it is a prize for first albums - but this year's shortlist included only two: Dove Ellis's heartfelt and delicate Blizzard, and Jade's That's Showbiz, Baby.

In the run-up to this year's ceremony, Olivia Dean had been the bookmakers' favourite for her second album, The Art of Loving.

An easy-going, soulful collection of love songs, it had already been named album of the year at the Brit Awards and the Mobos, and is widely expected to earn the singer a Grammy nomination in the same category next month.

Speaking backstage, the singer said she was overwhelmed by the success.

"I don't think I've processed it yet, to be honest," she said. "I feel like I'm still in this crazy whirlwind of it all.

"And maybe, when I take a break over Christmas, I'll reflect on the sofa."

Other nominees included the rapper Kojey Radical, Geordie jazz act Knats, and former Little Mix star Jade - who was the first ever X Factor winner to receive a Mercury nomination.

The shortlist also included the charity compilation album Help (2), recorded in aid of Warchild, which featured new music and cover versions by artists such as Olivia Rodrigo, Damon Albarn, Depeche Mode and The Last Dinner Party.

The tracklist also included nine former Mercury Prize winners: Arctic Monkeys, Young Fathers, Wolf Alice, Pulp, Sampha, Portishead's Beth Gibbons, Arlo Parks, English Teacher and Ezra Collective.

Last year, the prize was won by Newcastle singer-songwriter Sam Fender, who donated his £25,000 winnings to grassroots music venues , helping to support up-and-coming songwriters around the UK.

articles.title: Atlanta Falcons show off new profile pic on social media that some fans say resembles Nazi imagery
articles.summary: The NFC club said it doesn’t have a new logo but otherwise declined to comment on the look.
articles.body: The Atlanta Falcons showed off a retro team symbol on their social media platforms this week, sparking backlash across social media from fans who said the image bore an uncomfortable resemblance to World War II-era German Nazi imagery. Red, white and black stripes adorned the familiar Falcons logo on the team’s Instagram and X accounts Wednesday. It was called “New PFP” on X, shorthand for “new profile picture.” A team representative, reached late Thursday afternoon, said the Falcons do not have a “new logo” and declined any further comment. The Reichskriegsflagge-like imagery triggered a wave of taste-challenged World War II-themed comments and jokes on the Falcons’ social media pages. The artwork appeared to be an ill-advised effort to honor the expansion 1966 Atlanta Falcons. The Falcons next take the field Sunday, welcoming the San Francisco 49ers to Mercedes-Benz Stadium in an old-school NFC West showdown in which Atlanta is set to wear throwback threads. “Absolutely there was no ill intent, and I can’t imagine in a million years the Atlanta Falcons would do something like” seeking Nazi alignment, sports logo historian Chris Creamer told NBC News on Thursday. “It’s throwback weekend for the team, and the social media team just wanted to dress up like the players were going to, and it’s a very common thing that social media accounts do across all sports,” he said. “If a team’s wearing a throwback uniform, usually their profile photo will be updated to match that.” Creamer didn’t fault the Falcons for posting the image originally, but he wondered whether the team could have avoided some of the blowback. “I think if I was in the room with the Falcons, honestly, I wouldn’t have noticed it when I hit send,” he said. “But I would have, once the replies started coming in as fast as they were coming in and it spiraled out of control,” he said. “At that point, they could have taken it down and tried a different one. At this point, it just sort of seems kind of stubborn to keep it up.”

articles.title: Hundreds of Ethiopians cross into Kenya to flee regional fighting
articles.summary: Dispute over raising flag of Somali Regional State devolves into fighting between regional forces.
articles.body:
Hundreds of Ethiopians have crossed into Kenya, fleeing ⁠⁠fighting in ⁠⁠the border town of Moyale, which was reportedly prompted by loyalists publicly raising the flag of a neighbouring majority-Somali state.

Kenyan police said on Thursday that hundreds of Ethiopians, mostly women and children, crossed into Kenya through several entry points in Moyale, including the Sessi, Kore, Biashara, Foundation and Miti areas.

The people who crossed the border were fleeing tensions between leaders of Ethiopia’s Oromia and Somali regional states, according to Kenyan police.

The police reported gunfire and chaotic scenes in Moyale.

Ethiopian media reported that the fighting in Moyale started as a dispute over raising the flag of the Somali Regional State, a regional state in eastern Ethiopia, on Sunday.

Tensions escalated into fighting between forces from the Oromia and Somali regions.

The Kenya Red Cross said it was setting up temporary shelter and distributing essential items including cereal and porridge flour.

“The response will initially reach 1,000 households,” the Kenya Red Cross said in a statement on Thursday.

It added that experts were conducting an assessment to work out how many people were ⁠affected and what their needs were.

The regional clash is hundreds of kilometres away from ‌‌a larger conflict in the northern Tigray region between government forces and a rebel alliance led by the Tigray People’s ‌‌Liberation ‌‌Front.

articles.body: Parker McCollum has spent years chasing big whitetail bucks with his bow. articles.title: Give more people weight loss jabs on the NHS, say MPs
articles.summary: Current plans for 6% of eligible patients to get Mounjaro by 2028 unambitious, say MPs.
articles.body:
Hundreds of thousands more people should be given access to the weight-loss injection Mounjaro on the NHS in England, a cross-party group of MPs says.

The Health Committee said the current plan for 220,000 people to have this jab for free on prescription in 2028 was a "woefully small number" and "unambitious".

This represents only around 6% of eligible people and is a key reason why more than a million have been paying privately for weight-loss injections, including Mounjaro and Wegovy.

The committee says a two-tier system is emerging in which only the wealthy can get good access to the medication that curbs appetite.

Due to costs, the NHS is currently working on a 12-year rollout for Mounjaro - although this is being reviewed.

It is estimated that if all 2.8 million people eligible for the drug were given it immediately, it would cost the NHS £15.2 billion over five years.

Some of that expense is linked to the NHS relying heavily on GPs to oversee the prescribing and monitoring.

MPs say the NHS must learn from private providers who often use digital platforms to do some of this work.

The MPs said streamlining the process of support for patients could reduce that bill – and they said it also made financial sense because of the overall cost of obesity to the economy – estimated to be around £75 billion a year.

Another weight-loss injection, Wegovy, is available on the NHS, but only through specialist weight management services.

The committee also called for a crackdown on the black market for weight-loss drugs, saying the lack of availability on the NHS had driven people to buy unlicenced products online.

It wants a public awareness campaign to warn about the dangers, along with a review to look at how better to regulate online advertising.

The MPs also criticised the wider system of weight-loss services, saying they were poorly designed and resourced.

They want people to have better access to diet and lifestyle courses and bariatric (obesity) surgery.

Moran said obesity should be treated as a serious health condition, like diabetes.

"People can spend their entire lives battling with their weight. We say the NHS should provide effective, structured support to beat obesity for all those who seek it. Instead, those people are repeatedly failed," she said.

Jack Doughty, of the Obesity Health Alliance, said people living with obesity were being "let down by a fragmented and overstretched treatment system".

"The reality is that the existing treatment services, from behavioural support to weight-loss medications and bariatric surgery, remain patchy and unequal."

NHS England said it was looking at ways to accelerate roll out weight-loss drugs, but was currently “rightly prioritising these treatments for those with the most severe and complex needs“.
